verdict.rationale: Plaid is a developer API platform with SDKs, a Dashboard, Link, and an MCP server, so asking whether developers can opt out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question. The evidence pack contains no documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. Community complaints concern end-user financial-data sharing and consent, not telemetry controls. The 'link manually' tip is a user-side workaround, not an opt-out, so it earns no credit.
